title: Hyperlinks
subtitle: External URLs, e-mail and jumps inside the document

sections.title: External links
sections.body: http(s), mailto and tel links open in the reader. Anything else, such as javascript:, is left as plain text.

sections.title: Jumps inside the PDF
sections.body: href="#id" jumps to the element with that id, on whatever page it lands.

sections.title: Wrapped and block links
sections.body: A link that wraps onto several lines gets one clickable area per line; a block link is one box.
